Ground transport assumption: $12 CAD each way for YYZ (downtown Toronto ⇄ Pearson), $0 for YTZ (Billy Bishop is downtown). Totals always include this. "Best" compares bought-together (round-trip) vs. bought-separately (two one-ways) for the same pair of dates and airports, whichever is cheaper after transport.

Note: round-trip pricing is only used when the outbound and return airport match (e.g. YYZ→YYZ). Mixed-airport round-trips fall back to the separately-verified one-way sum, because round-trip results for a differing return airport have proven unreliable.

Buy signal: compares each week's latest price with its own lowest price of the previous 14 days and with the typical price (median best price across all tracked weeks, last 30 days of scrapes). Buy now = within 3% of its 14-day low and no more than 10% above typical.
